title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Timer T3485
entities.description: Timer used during dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure. On expiry, the MME resends ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and restarts timer. After fifth expiry, procedure is aborted.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered when dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure is aborted after fifth T3485 expiry.

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnect procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to disconnect a PDN connection.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN disconnection.

entities.name: Fifth expiry of timer T3485
entities.description: Condition when timer T3485 expires for the fifth time during dedicated EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: Collision with PDN disconnect procedure
entities.description: Condition when MME receives PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST during dedicated EPS bearer activation for the same PDN connection.

entities.name: Release allocated resources
entities.description: Action to release any resources allocated for the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure.

relations.description: Dedicated EPS bearer activation procedure starts timer T3485.
Procedure includes sending ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
Fifth expiry of T3485 stops the dedicated EPS bearer activation procedure.
Fifth T3485 expiry causes transition to BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE state.
Fifth T3485 expiry triggers release of allocated resources.
Collision with PDN disconnect procedure stops the dedicated EPS bearer activation.
Collision condition triggers release of procedure resources.
UE requested PDN disconnect procedure includes receiving PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
